before.transientPitchFinding: pluck.glass low-role probes measured 10.419 to 10.741 cents sharp

adoptedChanges.catalog: Per-preset output gains were moved to the measured within-family median; pad.motion received a further 0.16 dB chord-headroom trim; the obsolete shared 0.18 gain floor was removed because it clipped valid macro compensation after level matching.
adoptedChanges.pluckGlass: A 220 ms decay candidate cleared the local pitch gate but failed the frozen SQ-D Length continuity gate, so the production 150 ms decay was retained.
adoptedChanges.analyzer: Pitch anchors account for intentional sub oscillators; local-RMS normalization removes short-decay bias; pitch lag is interpolated; onset uses a 5 ms envelope; event discontinuity is the residual over adjacent musical slope in synth-only contexts.

decision: All 27 current defaults are retained for blinded human review. Technical proximity flags do not authorize automatic deletion.
